author: Hibachi1969
quote:
The best cinematic experience I've ever had in a video game.Everything is absolutely perfect and nerve-wracking. I loved almost everything about this game.

The characters and the story are written so well that everything that happens in the game evokes incredible emotions.

Unfortunately, I hate Naughty Dog, so I don't think we'll ever see another game like this, especially given what Neil Druckmann has become.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II Remastered

author: Hibachi1969
quote:
Simply perfect—the music, the design, the graphics.
The story is fantastic, the environments are amazing—this is how a remake should be done.

What impressed me the most is that Nintendo managed to modernize this game in an incredible way; with these graphics and 60 fps.

The combat is very fluid, but the story took me by surprise—it’s beautiful and managed to transport me to another dimension, as if I were a kid again. It reminded me a lot of some of my favorite anime series, especially those by Miyazaki.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Hibachi1969
quote:
It seems like Rockstar hasn’t learned a thing over the years, and has just thrown all the features added to RDR2 into this GTA **** these years, all this money, and they didn’t even think to run the game at least at 60 fps, add music to the streaming version, and maybe hire better writers—since the story was written by Mickey Mouse??

The story is super cliché and boring; practically everything revolves around building a relationship, and it’s all so heavily scripted that you have virtually no freedom to choose anything. Plus, the overall vibe doesn’t really feel like a GTA game—it feels like just any other game not made by Rockstar.
Also, I couldn't bring myself to care about any of the characters, because they all seem so cold and unreal—far removed from reality. I don't know if this is because the graphics are so realistic that, as a result, the poorly written characters seem too artificial and detached from the game itself.

The only positive things about this game are the graphics, of course (even though they have their own issues), and the fact that you can finally play a GTA game as a woman.
